encoding_notes: Referencing is the Harvard author-date system (in-text 'surname, year' in parentheses; reference list alphabetical) — no clean nlm/ama/vancouver slot, mapped to 'custom'.

In-text et al. rule: single author '(Gür, 1999)', two '(Gür and Akova, 2001)', more than two '(Gür et al., 2000)'. This is in-text only; the reference LIST lists ALL authors (example lists 6), so references.et_al_threshold left null to avoid wrongly truncating the reference list.
Reference example journal names are given in FULL (e.g. 'European Journal of Applied Physiology') -> journal_abbrev 'full'; examples show no DOI.
'There is no page and reference limitation for the manuscript' -> manuscript_max_words, references_max and references.max_count all null.
Margins '3 cm on all sides' = 30 mm; page size not stated (cm units hint A4 but unstated) -> page_size null.
TITLE must be in capital letters (ALL CAPS); misc.title_case enum has no 'upper' value -> null (schema gap).
Running head required, 'Maximum 5 words' (word-based); running_title_max_chars is char-based -> null.
REVIEW ARTICLE: JSSM accepts ONLY systematic review or meta-analysis -> mapped to systematic_review; title must include 'a Systematic Review'; PRISMA checklist + flow diagram required in Methods.
'Brief reports' and conference/symposium summaries are mentioned as acceptable but have no prescribed structure/clean type slot -> omitted from article_types.

Letter to the Editor: limited to 2-3 pages, 5-8 references (references_min 5 / references_max 8), and a max of 2 tables/figures combined (or 1 table + 1 figure) — combined cap does not fit figures_max/tables_max, left null.

Figures: guide states 'GIF, or TIFF format' (+ MS Office Word/Excel/PowerPoint); JPEG used for photos/biography and figure file-name examples (GurFigure1.jpg). GIF and Office formats are not in the schema enum -> formats limited to tiff/jpg/jpeg.
Figure resolution 96 dpi; still-art files limited to 700 KB.
Figure files named with main author surname + 'Figure' + number (e.g. GurFigure1.jpg); tables/figures submitted as separate files with in-text location indicated.

Double-blind review is stated, but the guide gives NO explicit separate-title-page or identifier/metadata-scrub instruction and even asks authors to name figure files with the main author's surname -> separate_title_page and scrub_* set false.
Highlights required: 'Provide a box with 3-5 bullet points listing the key points of the paper' (checklist) -> highlights_required true (3-5 bullets).
Research-article abstract 'not more than 300 words that includes objectives, methods, results, and conclusions' — describes required content, not labeled headings -> structured false, sections null.
Author biography (~50 words per author with degrees/affiliation/research focus/e-mail and optional JPEG photo) required — no schema slot.

Conflict of interest must always be stated ('none declared' if none) -> required; funding acknowledged in Acknowledgment section; ethics (Declaration of Helsinki + legal-compliance declaration at end of acknowledgments) and patient consent/anonymity required for human/animal or identifiable-patient work (conditional).
AI-use disclosure required in Acknowledgment or Methods section; copyright transfer statement required at submission; author royalty fee USD 3300 / EUR 2900 / GBP 2500 (not a formatting field).
A signed 'letter of submission' from the corresponding author is referenced but not listed as a required cover-letter deliverable -> cover_letter_required false (uncertain).
2026-07-18 doctrine audit: line_numbers 'none' was a default, not a guide statement — nulled so the engine preserves the author's setting.
